record.question: As explanation given under section 480, where a person is unable to give bail bond within _________ of the date of his arrest, it shall be a sufficient ground for the officer or the Court to presume that he is an indigent person for the purposes of this proviso:
record.explanation: The BNSS presumes indigence if bail bond is not furnished within a week of arrest.
